title: loam worktree new --dry-run --json
description: The dry run of worktree new. It changes nothing and never asks origin, so the branch checks and the default base read the last fetched state.

name.description: The name that was checked. It is the branch name.

folder.description: The folder name that the worktree would get, such as web-fix-login.

valid_name.description: False when the name is not a good branch name.

name_error.description: Why the name is not a good branch name. It is present only when valid_name is false.

worktree_exists.description: True when the plot already has the worktree, or its folder exists. worktree new would refuse it.

branch_exists.description: True when a local branch or a branch of origin has the name. It is false when the name is not valid.

default_base.description: The base of a new branch when no base is given, such as origin/main. It comes from origin/HEAD of the last fetch, and it is empty without one.

bases.description: The branches that a new branch can start from: default_base first, then the branches of origin, then the local branches, each with the newest commit first.

seed_line.description: The line that the seed of the plot gets for the worktree, with the goal, the link and the base of this check, such as '- web-fix-login: Fix the login form (#57, from origin/main)'. It is present only when valid_name is true.
